subject.title: fix(automerge): merge ready behind heads directly

question: Should automerge permit a `BEHIND` head to merge on exact-head checks alone, or must it first obtain validation of the current three-way merge result?
rationale: This is a repository-wide merge-safety policy choice: the code can mechanically enforce either option, but it cannot determine how much post-merge integration risk maintainers are willing to accept.

options.title: Require merge-result validation
options.body: Add a direct-automerge scenario and gate `BEHIND` readiness on successful validation of the current merge result before allowing the squash merge.

options.title: Keep rebase repair
options.body: Retain the current conservative `BEHIND` repair path until a merge-result validation mechanism is available.

options.title: Accept exact-head-only merging
options.body: Allow the change as written and explicitly accept that head checks may not cover integration with newer base changes.

recommendation.title: Require merge-result validation
recommendation.body: Add a direct-automerge scenario and gate `BEHIND` readiness on successful validation of the current merge result before allowing the squash merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository policy identifies Peter as the available decision route for workflow behavior that affects foreign pull requests and automerge.
